content.text:
I fixed all three problems in `src/queue.js`, and `npm test` passes (5 of 5).

- **Hang after a failure:** a rejected job never freed its slot, and a job that threw synchronously or returned a plain value broke the queue. Every job's outcome is now normalised, and the slot is always released afterwards. A failing job rejects only its own promise.
- **`onIdle()` resolving early:** it only checked that nothing was pending. It now also waits until nothing is running.
- **One job at a time after `pause()`/`resume()`:** `next()` started at most one job per call. It now loops until all free slots are filled, so `resume()` starts up to `concurrency` jobs.

I added three tests to `test/queue.test.js`, one for each problem. I didn't run them against the old code to confirm they fail there.
